name: Chrome Hearts Leather Cargo Pants 'Articulated'
basis_of_authenticity: Dealer listing: sold as authentic by YP Collective. No outside legit check; the basis is the dealer only.
model: Black heavyweight cow leather cargo pants, adjustable leg tabs, button fly. Dealer calls it a new release.
what_the_tags_read: Leather label: embossed scroll, CHROME HEARTS in gothic letters; under it a gothic "USA" between two small cross marks. Stitched all round.
Leather tab under the label: embossed "32".
Size tag: CHROME HEARTS scroll, "32", "175 / 88B"; "RN" visible at the fold.
Composition tag: "BODY: LEATHER: COW / LINING: 100% COTTON"; "CORPS: CUIR: VACHE / DOUBLURE: 100% COTON"; Japanese, Korean, Chinese; "MADE IN U.S.A.".

White printed care tag: five care symbols, "PROFESSIONAL LEATHER DRY CLEAN ONLY", "NETTOYAGE À SEC PROFESSIONNEL DU CUIR UNIQUEMENT", then Japanese, Korean and Chinese lines; CHROME HEARTS scroll sideways on the facing tag.
Inside: a grey suede-like surface in these photos; no emblem print visible.
